name: Ivan Diaz-Rainey
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart session 1 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society (archived programme page) lists Ivan Diaz-Rainey as an author of “Spatial data quality and veracity”.

The GeoCart and New Zealand geospatial research material contains a variant spelling, 'Ian Diaz-Rainey', for the 2022 coastal flooding and residential-property study. University of Otago STRAND records name Professor Ivan Diaz-Rainey as a researcher in the same spatial-property project. These records support a single person; the 'Ian' variant is retained as a source-specific spelling rather than counted as a separate contributor.
